description: Explain government, insurance, tax, immigration, school, and legal notices — and the required actions.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Paste any official notice, get plain English plus ranked actions and extracted deadlines, all client-side — this is the rare tool people will genuinely forward to friends. But the business model is nonprofits and government white-labels: noble, slow, and thin. Viral utility, weak business — the classic.
Translate CTA produces plain-English actions + deadlines from sample summons; zero errors.

notes.change: Deadlines card gained 'Add deadlines to calendar (.ics)' — exports extracted dates as a valid multi-event ICS file (verified 3 VEVENTs, correct DTSTARTs). README next-3 #3 done; missing-deadlines is the thesis, so this completes the loop.
